Messages.Author: Thalco
Messages.Body:
Glad you got the help. Lackey should have a bunch of precons saved when it installs. The 5e decks are fairly strong and great for learning. If you're looking to build your own decks I'd advise using one of those and tweaking it as you play until it feels more comfortable as your style. Deck building from scratch is challenging in vtes and you want to build up some good game and card knowledge before you jump in.

. Prince of Liverpool and UK NC
